author: Rafael Quintanilha
central_question: Whether increasingly capable AI means frontend development is ending
thesis: AI can make the implementation of an existing interface substantially more efficient
Implementing a supplied design is not the whole job of frontend development
Human judgment remains necessary to decide whether an interface is intuitive, functional, pleasant, and useful
The implementation can be technically correct while the interface itself is poorly conceived
Frontend specialists should broaden their range, use AI for bounded implementation work, and cultivate product and usability judgment
qualification: The essay rejects both panic about the end of frontend and complacency about the effects of AI
